class.name: CellCharacterBody
class.brief_description: A [CellPlayerBody] that handles its own acceleration, gravity and view.

method.name: add_view_input
method.description: Adds to the pending [member view_input] instead of replacing it. Use this from an input callback: several mouse events can arrive inside one physics frame.

method.name: get_horizontal_velocity
method.description: The X and Z of [member velocity].

method.name: get_move_direction
method.description: The world-space direction [member move_input] points at, on the horizontal plane and relative to where [member yaw_node] faces. Unit length, or zero when there is no input.

method.name: get_view_pitch
method.description: The pitch of [member pitch_node], in degrees.

method.name: get_view_yaw
method.description: The yaw of [member yaw_node], in degrees.

method.name: jump
method.description: Jumps with [member jump_speed] on the next movement step, if the body is on the floor by then. A jump asked for in mid-air is dropped. Emits [signal jumped] when it happens.

method.name: process_movement
method.description: Runs one movement step: acceleration, gravity, jump, then [method KinematicBody.move_and_slide_with_snap]. Called automatically while [member movement_enabled] is on.

method.name: process_view
method.description: Runs one view step: consumes [member view_input], smooths it and turns the view. Called automatically while [member view_enabled] is on.

method.name: rotate_view
method.description: Turns the view by [code]degrees.x[/code] of yaw and [code]degrees.y[/code] of pitch. The pitch is clamped to [member view_pitch_min] / [member view_pitch_max].

method.name: set_view_pitch
method.description: Sets the pitch of [member pitch_node], clamped.

members.member: How fast the horizontal velocity eases toward the input direction. It is the rate of [code]lerp(velocity, target, acceleration * delta)[/code].
Multiplier on [member acceleration] and [member deceleration] while off the floor. [code]0[/code] keeps the take-off velocity untouched.
Same as [member acceleration], used when there is no input.
Steepest slope, in degrees, that counts as a floor. The body cannot walk up anything steeper.
Downward acceleration applied while the body is not on the floor.
Passed to [method KinematicBody.move_and_slide_with_snap]. Off, so a [RigidBody] in the way pushes back instead of being bulldozed.
Upward velocity given by [method jump].
Terminal velocity. [code]0[/code] means no limit.
Passed to [method KinematicBody.move_and_slide_with_snap].
Horizontal speed reached at full [member move_input]. Change it at runtime for walk, run and sprint.
The wanted movement: [code]x[/code] is strafe (right positive), [code]y[/code] is forward / back (forward negative). A length under 1 scales the speed. Runtime only, not saved.
Whether the movement step runs by itself. Turning it off also clears [member velocity].
The [Spatial] that looks up and down, usually a child of [member yaw_node] holding the camera. Empty disables pitch.
How far down the body is held to the floor on slopes and steps. Released while jumping or moving upward.
Passed to [method KinematicBody.move_and_slide_with_snap].
With no input, a horizontal speed below this is set to zero.
The current velocity. Set it to launch or stop the body. Runtime only, not saved.
Whether the view step runs by itself. Turning it off discards pending [member view_input].
Pending view motion ([code]x[/code] yaw, [code]y[/code] pitch), consumed by the next view step. Setting it replaces what is pending; see [method add_view_input]. Runtime only, not saved.
Highest pitch, in degrees.
Lowest pitch, in degrees.
Degrees turned per unit of [member view_input].
Rate the view eases toward its input, like [member acceleration]. [code]0[/code] applies the input raw.
The [Spatial] that turns left and right, and that movement is relative to. Empty turns the body itself.

signal.name: jumped
signal.description: Emitted when a [method jump] actually leaves the floor.
